meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (codified continental system, constitutional monarchy, unitary state)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Ley 10/2010, de 28 de abril, de prevención del blanqueo de capitales y de la financiación del terrorismo (as amended by Ley 1/2019 and Real Decreto-ley 7/2021); Real Decreto 304/2014, de 5 de mayo, Reglamento de la Ley 10/2010; Real Decreto 613/2023, de 11 de julio, creating the Registro Central de Titularidades Reales (RCTR); UBO obligations also embedded in the incorporation deed through the Ley de Sociedades de Capital (Real Decreto Legislativo 1/2010, de 2 de julio).
ubo_and_aml_profiling.ubo_disclosure_level: Government_Only_Access: the Registro Central de Titularidades Reales (RCTR) and the provincial Registro Mercantil records are not publicly searchable; access is restricted to competent authorities, notaries, registrars, obliged entities verifying legitimate interest, and journalists/civil-society organizations under the AMLD transposition framework.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificación negativa de denominación social (negative company-name clearance certificate)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Domestic Registry certificate; notarially authenticated copy for the incorporation deed - no apostille required

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Valid national ID or passport of each shareholder (natural person) and each director
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Police or passport authority of the holder's country of nationality/residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarial certified copies; if executed before a foreign notary, the certification page requires Apostille (Hague Convention, Spain in force since 14 Dec 1978) or full consular legalization for non-Hague states

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Criminal record certificate (certificado de antecedentes penales) for each director and legal representative
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Registro Central de Penados y Rebeldes (Spanish Ministry of Justice) or equivalent foreign judicial authority
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille and sworn Spanish translation (traducción jurada); Spanish-issued certificates require no apostille

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified charter, incorporation certificate and certificate of good standing of any corporate shareholder (e.g., the ultimate parent)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Commercial registry or notary of the jurisdiction of incorporation of the corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (or Spanish consular legalization for non-Hague jurisdictions) plus sworn Spanish translation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Power of attorney (poder de representación) appointing the incorporator and local representative
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary in the grantor's jurisdiction or a Spanish notary for powers granted in Spain
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization; notarial protocolization in Spain within the document's validity window

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory risk-based KYC/CDD under arts. 3-5 and 14 of Ley 10/2010 and arts. 23-24 of Real Decreto 304/2014: each UBO, director, and corporate shareholder's ultimate controller must be screened against the EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List (EUR-Lex), OFAC SDN and Consolidated Non-SDN lists, the UN Security Council Consolidated List, Interpol and national police alerts, and checked against the RCTR. Persons with Public Responsibilities (PEPs) trigger enhanced due diligence under art. 14.2 Ley 10/2010. The transaction tier is Low_Risk_Standard, so simplified due diligence may apply only where source-of-funds documentation is clean; any PEP, sanctions, adverse-media, or source-of-wealth red flag automatically elevates the file to enhanced due diligence. Records of screening and UBO identification must be retained for 10 years from the termination of the business relationship.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Sede Electrónica del Registro Mercantil Central (www.rmc.es); electronic name certification also accessible via the CIRCE / PAIT (Punto de Atención al Emprendedor) platform
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The denomination must be in Spanish (Castilian); co-official languages (Catalan, Basque, Galician) are permitted where the registered office is located in the corresponding autonomous community, but a Spanish version must be included; the name must be written in Latin-script alphabets; foreign company-style terms are accepted only when transliterated and consistent with the corporate form (SL). The name must not be identical or misleadingly similar to an existing registered company, must not solely describe corporate activity, and must not create confusion with public institutions or regulated sectors.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: The negative name certificate is valid for 6 months; extension is not formally extendable but a fresh application may be filed before expiry to maintain priority. On rejection, the applicant may: (1) file a reconsideration request (recurso de reposición) with the Registro Mercantil Central within 1 month; (2) file an administrative appeal (recurso de alzada) with the Dirección General de Seguridad Jurídica y Fe Pública of the Ministry of Justice within 1 month of the reconsideration decision; and (3) if the administrative remedies are exhausted, initiate contentious-administrative judicial review (recurso contencioso-administrativo) before the Audiencia Nacional within 2 months. Counsel must re-run the RMC name search before each appeal and, if the preferred name remains blocked, an immediately available alternative name should be reserved in parallel.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Acceptable as a registered address only where the company maintains in Spain a genuine administrative establishment capable of receiving official notifications and where effective management is materially verified in Spain; a purely virtual registered office is administratively registered but carries AEAT re-classification risk under arts. 8 and 16 of the Ley del Impuesto sobre Sociedades (non-resident status or disregarded substance). For this wholesale optical-frames business, a virtual office combined with a local third-party logistics warehouse, a resident commercial manager, and local banking accounts constitutes market-standard substance and requires no additional sectoral license.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Quantified risk of unannounced physical on-site inspection in the first 12 months: approximately 3% (low). The Registro Mercantil does not conduct routine physical inspections; AEAT inspection risk rises to approximately 10-15% upon first intra-EEA or third-country import/export movements, VAT refund claims, or an accounting-model mismatch; SEPBLAC AML inspection risk is negligible for the Low_Risk_Standard wholesale category absent filing anomalies or sanctions-list hits.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Negative name clearance certificate (certificación negativa de denominación social) - electronic application via RMC
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Official RMC fee schedule for electronic name-certification applications

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarial execution of the deed of incorporation (escritura de constitución de SL) including statutory UBO identification statement
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Spanish notary (Colegio Notarial of the chosen seat)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Official notarial tariff (arancel notarial) for incorporation deeds; standard range for an SL with EUR 3,000 minimum capital and up to two shareholders

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: First registration in the provincial Registro Mercantil (registro mercantil provincial) of the new SL
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Official registrars' tariff (arancel de los registradores) calculated on subscribed capital and number of registry entries

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Provisional corporate tax identification number (NIF provisional) - model 036/037 electronic filing with the Agencia Tributaria
Initial filing with the Registro Central de Titularidades Reales (RCTR) - UBO register declaration
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Registradores de España / Ministry of Justice (RCTR)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory fee for electronic submission of the beneficial ownership record

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Hague Apostille processing and sworn Spanish translation (traducción jurada) of foreign corporate shareholder documents and directors' criminal records
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Competent apostille authority of the document's country of origin + sworn translator (traductor-jurado)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Hague Apostille per-document fee in origin jurisdiction plus official Spanish sworn-translation tariff (approximately EUR 80-150 per document)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: AML/UBO due diligence counsel: PEP, OFAC, EU, UN and domestic sanctions screening, UBO-chart preparation, risk-tier assessment and legal opinion
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for pre-incorporation AML/KYC advisory (flat fee for a low-risk wholesale entity)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Gestoría administration: CIRCE/PAIT coordination, notary and registry logistics, document preparation and status monitoring
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark flat fee for SL incorporation management

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Real Decreto Legislativo 1/2010, de 2 de julio, por el que se aprueba el texto refundido de la Ley de Sociedades de Capital (Spanish Companies Act, LSC), Articles 4, 20-22, 28-29, 63 and 209-213; Reglamento del Registro Mercantil (Real Decreto 1784/1996, de 19 de julio); Ley 18/2022, de 28 de septiembre, de creación y crecimiento de empresas.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registro Mercantil Provincial de Madrid (Provincial Mercantile Registry of Madrid) for final inscription; Registro Mercantil Central (Central Mercantile Registry) for the negative name certificate.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Escritura Pública de Constitución (Public Deed of Incorporation) granted before a Spanish Notary, followed by inscription in the Mercantile Registry.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: Statutory minimum EUR 3,000 (Article 4.1 LSC) fully subscribed and fully paid up in cash at constitution. Note: the ES_SL metadata flag minimum_capital_requirement: false conflicts with Spanish law; the EUR 3,000 minimum is mandatory for an SL. No escrow account is otherwise required, but the payment must be evidenced by a certificate of deposit issued by a Spanish credit institution or by a bank guarantee that remains at the Notary's disposal until the deed is granted.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED: First General Meeting of Shareholders held in Madrid on the execution date, all shareholders attending, validly constituted. The share capital of EUR 3,000 is fully subscribed in 3,000 indivisible participations of EUR 1.00 nominal value each; shareholders acknowledge the bank certificate evidencing full payment. RESOLVED FURTHER: the bylaws, including corporate object, financial year and registered office in Madrid, are adopted. RESOLVED FURTHER: Mr./Ms. [Name] is appointed sole administrator with all corporate powers, and Mr./Ms. [Name] is appointed secretary, jointly empowered to execute the public deed before a Notary, settle transfer tax, obtain the provisional NIF, and file the Mercantile Registry registration.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtain NIE (Foreigner Tax Number) and Verify Investor Capacity
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Oficina de Extranjería de la Comisaría General de Extranjería y Fronteras (National Police Foreigners Office) or Spanish Consulate in the investor's country of residence
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the EX-15 application before signing the public deed. Foreign shareholders must be physically present or act through a notarized power of attorney granted to a Spanish resident. All foreign corporate documents must be apostilled and translated by a sworn translator into Spanish.
required_dossiers: EX-15 application form
Original passport or national ID of each shareholder
Apostilled certificate of incorporation and power of attorney for corporate shareholders
Sworn Spanish translation of foreign corporate documents
Proof of address and economic means or investor visa documentation
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried, correct the defects (missing apostille or translation) and resubmit within 10 working days at the same office; alternatively apply through the Spanish Consulate in the investor's country, or request an urgent short-term NIE at the Central Foreigners Office with the corporate transaction evidence.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Request Negative Name Certificate from the Central Mercantile Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Mercantil Central (Central Mercantile Registry), online platform of the Colegio de Registradores
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit an online request with an electronic certificate, indicating up to three proposed company names in order of preference. The Registry checks the existence of identical or confusingly similar names and issues the certificación negativa de denominación social, which is valid for three months and must correspond exactly to the name used in the deed.
required_dossiers: Electronic request form for denomination certificates
Up to three proposed names in priority order
Digital certificate of the applicant(s)
Identity of the promoters and stated corporate purpose
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the requested names are rejected for similarity, the applicant automatically falls to the next candidate name; if all are rejected, file a new application with alternative names. Ensure the deed is executed before the three-month validity of the certificate expires; otherwise obtain a new certificate.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Open Corporate Bank Account and Deposit the Minimum Share Capital
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Spanish credit institution of the company's choice (e.g., registered bank with KYC/AML compliance desk for companies in formation)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a bank account in the name of the sociedad en formación, deposit EUR 3,000, and instruct the bank to issue a certificate of deposit (certificado de desembolso) stating that the funds are blocked and at the disposal of the Notary until the deed is granted. Provide full KYC/AML documentation for shareholders, directors and beneficial owners.
required_dossiers: Bank account opening application for a company in formation
KYC/AML forms and proof of identity of shareholders and directors
Proof of NIE of each administrator
Draft bylaws and proposed corporate purpose for the bank file
Source of funds statement for the EUR 3,000 deposit
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank refuses opening due to enhanced due diligence, supplement the beneficial ownership declaration and refile the KYC interview; alternatively open the account at another Spanish bank or, where the institution permits, constitute the company with a bank guarantee in lieu of the cash deposit.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execute Public Deed of Incorporation before a Spanish Notary
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notario de Madrid (Notary Public with competence in the seat of the company; chosen by the founders)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Attend the notarial appointment with all shareholders or their representatives. The Notary reviews the negative name certificate, the bank deposit certificate, and the bylaws; checks the NIE of the signatories; and reads and authorizes the Escritura Pública de Constitución. All signatories must be ready to pay the notarial tariff.
required_dossiers: Valid negative name certificate (issued within the last 3 months, under the exact company name)
NIE of all signatories or valid power of attorney
Certificate of deposit of the EUR 3,000 share capital
Approved bylaws (estatutos), signature sheets, and subscription statement
Passports or IDs of all attending shareholders
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Notary raises deficiencies (expired name certificate, missing NIE, or bylaw reservations), cure the cause by obtaining a renewed certificate or an NIE, or amend the bylaws and reschedule the appointment; no state filing occurs until the deed is validly granted.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Pay Transfer Tax and Stamp Duty (ITP/AJD) and Request Provisional Tax ID (NIF)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Servicio de Tributos de la Comunidad de Madrid (Regional Tax Office) and Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria (AEAT)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Within 30 working days of the deed date, self-assess the AJD transfer tax on model 600 at the regional treasury (1% of the nominal capital for most municipalities) and obtain the payment receipt. Thereafter, present the deed and the receipt to AEAT to request the provisional NIF (provisional CIF) of the company, using model 036 marked for a provisional tax ID.
required_dossiers: First copy (matriz) of the public deed and authorized second copies
Modelo 600 self-assessment of the AJD
Payment receipt from the regional treasury
Modelo 036 filed with AEAT for the provisional CIF
Authorization of the administrator as tax representative
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the self-assessment is rejected for an incorrect taxable base or municipality code, file a rectification on model 600 before the expiration of the 30-working-day period; if the deadline is missed, pay the late-filing surcharge and interest to avoid penalty escalation. If AEAT does not issue the provisional NIF, verify that the deed is complete and resubmit the 036.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Register the Company in the Provincial Mercantile Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Mercantil Provincial de Madrid (Provincial Mercantile Registry corresponding to the registered office)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Within one month from the date of the deed, present the first copy of the public deed, the certificate of capital deposit, and the AJD payment receipt to the Provincial Mercantile Registry. The Registrar reviews legality and issues the qualification resulting in the inscription of the company. After inscription, the company acquires full legal personality.
required_dossiers: First copy of the public deed of incorporation
Copy of the certificate of deposit of the share capital
Receipt of payment of ITP/AJD (modelo 600)
Provisional NIF certificate issued by AEAT
Registration fee deposit slip for the registry tariff
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar issues a defect notice (nota de defectos), cure the deficiencies within 60 days of the presentation note (asiento de presentación) by filing the required corrective documents; if the defects are not curable by documentation, execute a corrective notarial deed. If the period expires, the presentation lapses and a new submission is required.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Apply for Definitive NIF and File Tax Census Form 036
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria (AEAT) — territorial office with jurisdiction over the registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After the registry inscription certificate is issued, present it to AEAT together with the provisional NIF to obtain the definitive NIF certificate. Simultaneously complete the census registration on model 036, including the legal form, corporate purpose, VAT section (generally section one as a wholesaler), and withholding registration, to close the incorporation tax formalities.
required_dossiers: Certificate of inscription issued by the Provincial Mercantile Registry
Provisional NIF certificate of the company
Modelo 036 census declaration in full
Authorization of the tax representative or administrator
Copy of the public deed if required for verification
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If AEAT cannot issue the definitive NIF due to a mismatch between registry data and the census declaration, correct the data and resubmit the 036; request a certified copy of the registry entry if a data difference exists. If non-resident directors are involved, appoint a tax representative to AEAT before requesting the certificate.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtain Municipal Opening License and Register for Social Security
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Concejalía de Urbanismo y Licencias del Ayuntamiento de Madrid (Municipal Licensing Office) and Tesorería General de la Seguridad Social (TGSS)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the municipal responsible declaration or opening-license application for the warehouse and office premises used for the wholesale distribution activity, attaching the lease or title deed, occupancy certificate and technical compliance reports. Register the company and its administrators in the Social Security regime (employer registration on modelo TA.6) and, where hiring begins, register employees and contract an occupational risk prevention service.
required_dossiers: Municipal application or declaración responsable de inicio de actividad
Proof of title or lease and certificate of occupancy
Fire-safety compliance statement signed by a qualified technician
Occupational risk prevention plan (Ley 31/1995)
Modelo TA.6 employer registration and DUNS/REA company code
Payment receipt of the municipal fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the municipality orders suspension because a full license is required rather than a responsible declaration, complete the missing technical reports (acoustics, fire safety, accessibility) and obtain the express license before commencing operations. If TGSS rejects the employer registration, correct the company code and data and resubmit via the RED system without interruption of the consultation calendar.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Concejalía de Desarrollo Urbano y Urbanismo del Ayuntamiento de Madrid (Municipal Department of Urban Planning and Licensing) for commercial and storage premises; no industrial authorization required because the activity is wholesale distribution (ISIC 4646) without in-situ manufacturing of eyeglass frames.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Licencia de Apertura y Funcionamiento or Declaración Responsable de Inicio de Actividad (Municipal Opening and Operation License or Responsible Declaration of Commencement of Activity) for wholesale warehousing, showroom and administrative offices.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Dirección General de Sostenibilidad y Economía Circular, Consejería de Medio Ambiente de la Comunidad de Madrid (Regional Environment Authority); Ministerio para la Transición Ecológica y el Reto Demográfico (MITECO) only for national cross-border waste issues.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category 3 - No Full EIA Required. Wholesale distribution of acetate eyeglass frames (ISIC 4646) is not listed in Annexes I or II of Law 21/2013 on environmental assessment; the company is only subject to municipal environmental intervention via the responsible declaration and to registration as a producer of non-hazardous packaging waste in the Regional Waste Producer Registry.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No industrial process wastewater and no VOC emissions generated by the activity (dry warehousing and office use); only sanitary wastewater discharged to the municipal sewer in compliance with the local ordinance limits. Packaging residues must be segregated and transferred to an authorized waste manager under Law 7/2022 on waste and contaminated soils and Royal Decree 1055/2022 on packaging and packaging waste; any limited hazardous wastes (WEEE, batteries, fluorescent tubes) must be handed to a registered gestor with waste transfer certificates. Acoustic and emission limits of the Ayuntamiento de Madrid must be respected where a ventilation system is installed in the warehouse.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Occupancy and fire-safety certification for the warehouse and offices visited by the municipal technical services (Reglamento de Seguridad contra Incendios en los Establecimientos Industriales, RD 2267/2004, only where storage load exceeds thresholds); structural load clearance by a qualified architect for shelving exceeding 3.00 m; workplace clearance and occupational risk prevention plan under Ley 31/1995, including emergency and evacuation signage, fire extinguishers, and insurance; inspection protocols of the Ayuntamiento de Madrid for opening operation are completed through the single licensing window.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria (AEAT) - Spanish State Tax Administration Agency; electronic portal: Sede Electrónica de la AEAT (https://sede.agenciatributaria.gob.es). AEAT administers corporate income tax, VAT, customs duties and withholding taxes in common-territory Spain.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign investor must first obtain a Spanish NIE (Número de Identificación de Extranjero) or, for non-resident entities, an NIF-IE via Form 036/030 with the appropriate consular/postal authentication. The SL obtains a provisional NIF by filing Form 036 (Declaración censal) with the competent local AEAT office before notarization, attaching the draft articles of association and approved investor documentation. The notary requires the provisional NIF to execute the public deed of incorporation. After registration of the deed in the Registro Mercantil, the SL must file Form 036 within one month to convert the provisional NIF into the definitive NIF. In the same Form 036 filing, the SL completes census enrollment in the IAE (epigraph 4646 for wholesale optical goods), the VAT registration with Spanish domestic, intra-EU and non-EU export activity codes, and appointment of a tax representative if any shareholder or manager is resident outside the EU/EEA and lacks a permanent establishment in Spain. The company must also obtain an FNMT digital certificate, Cl@ve PIN or electronic ID to access AEAT e-filing APIs and the SII system.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation: A Spanish SL (Sociedad de Responsabilidad Limitada) is a distinct taxable person under Ley 27/2014 (Impuesto sobre Sociedades), resident and subject to worldwide taxation because it is incorporated and maintained in Spain. No pass-through or fiscal transparency is available to a standard SL. The standard CIT rate is 25%; a newly created SL may apply 15% to the first EUR 300,000 of taxable base in the first two tax years in which activity is carried on. Non-resident shareholders without a Spanish permanent establishment are subject to Impuesto sobre la Renta de No Residentes (IRNR) on Spanish-source dividends and interest; EU/EEA corporate shareholders may claim the Parent-Subsidiary Directive (2011/96/EU) transposition to reduce or eliminate withholding tax.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Spain does not operate a check-the-box or comparably elective entity classification regime; an SL is by law an entity-level taxpayer. Available statutory elections include: (i) consolidated tax group election for Spanish groups meeting the 70% direct/indirect capital threshold (Arts. 58-70 LIS); (ii) the ETVE participation-exemption mechanism (Art. 21 LIS) and the foreign permanent establishment exemption/option-to-tax regime (Art. 22 LIS); (iii) the patent box regime (Art. 23 LIS) for qualifying intangible income; (iv) the 15% reduced rate for newly created SLs in the first two years; and (v) optional tax-transparent treatment only for unrecognized foreign entities in strict statutory cases. Hybrid mismatch rules transposing ATAD apply automatically without election.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: IVA - Impuesto sobre el Valor Añadido (Spanish VAT, Ley 37/1992, implementing EU Council Directive 2006/112/EC); customs duties and excise are separately administered by AEAT's Department of Customs and Excise.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Not applicable for corporations: the SL must register for VAT (Alta en el censo IVA, Form 036) before the first taxable transaction. A corporate wholesale distributor cannot use the simplified VAT regimes or recargo de equivalencia, which are reserved for natural persons; therefore no economic turnover threshold limits registration. Registration is triggered by the mere commencement of economic activity in Spain.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory structured e-invoicing for Spanish B2B transactions under Ley 18/2022 (Crea y Crece) using the Facturae 3.2 XML format and interoperable platforms. Large taxpayers with annual turnover above EUR 6,000,000, VAT groups, and monthly self-assessors must file real-time invoice books to AEAT under the SII (Suministro Inmediato de Información) system through HTTPS/API services with X.509 client certificates, reporting invoices within 4 business days (8 calendar days). All invoicing and cash-register software must comply with Verifactu (Real Decreto 1007/2023), generating hash-chained invoice records, tamper-proof metadata and compliance codes. Spain does not impose a pre-clearance digital stamp, but export declarations are processed through the electronic customs system (DUA/CSD security codes), and intra-EU supplies must be validated against VIES and reported on EC-Sales Lists (Modelo 349). Invoices addressed to Latin American or other non-EU customers are not subject to the Spanish B2B e-invoicing format, but the evidence of export, transport and collection must still be available to AEAT under the same audit timeframe.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: A 0% VAT rate applies to definitive exports of goods to non-EU territories, including Latin American countries, under Art. 21.Dos of Ley 37/1992, provided title and risk pass to the foreign purchaser and the goods physically leave EU customs territory within the statutory period (generally 90 days from dispatch; extension available only with prior AEAT authorization). Exempt (not zero-rated) intra-EU dispatches require the customer's VIES-valid VAT ID and submission of EC-Sales Lists. Certain international services, including physically offshore services, transport and ancillary services, and commissions on foreign sales, are exempt under Art. 21.Uno and Art. 22 Ley 37/1992. The exporter must hold contemporaneous evidence of the payment flow, transport documents and commercial contract. Spain does not impose a statutory FX repatriation deadline, but AEAT audit practice treats collection evidence older than 180 days from export as requiring enhanced substantiation and third-party bank confirmation to avoid reclassification as a fictitious export.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: DUA - Documento Único Administrativo (electronic customs export declaration) including the final export summary declaration with CSD security code
Bill of Lading, Air Waybill or CMR consignment note evidencing physical departure from EU customs territory and delivery to the non-EU consignee
Commercial invoice and packing list stating Incoterms 2020 rule (e.g., FOB, CIF, EXW) and the free-on-board value
Inward remittance evidence (SWIFT MT103 or bank account statement) matching the export invoice value and payment rail
VIES validation output and EU VAT registration number of the customer for any intra-EU exempt dispatch
EC-Sales List (Modelo 349) and Intrastat declaration for intra-EU movements when the applicable annual threshold is exceeded
Export exit verification (e.g., customs transit TC32LRN, foreign port entry stamp or certificate of import of the destination customs authority) where available
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: AEAT may verify the export exemption within the 4-year statute of limitations; missing or contradictory export evidence causes reversal of the 0% rate, assessment of 21% VAT with late-payment interest, and correction of the relevant Form 303/390 returns. Proportional penalties apply under Arts. 191-194 of Ley 58/2003: 50%-100% for grave infringements and up to 150% for very grave infringements, with the penalty base being the undeclared VAT. Intentional fictitious exports involving amounts exceeding EUR 120,000 per year may be referred for criminal prosecution under Art. 305 of the Criminal Code. Customs infringement proceedings may separately impose fines up to 150% of the customs value, suspension of the exporter's customs authorization (including AEO simplifications), and joint liability of the customs agent for falsified DUA data. Voluntary correction before notification reduces or eliminates penalties, and a successful clawback also disallows any related refunds or input VAT deductions.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de España, acting jointly with the Dirección General de Comercio Internacional e Inversiones of the Ministry of Economy, Trade and Enterprise and the Comisión Nacional del Mercado de Valores (CNMV) for external transaction monitoring, balance-of-payments statistical reporting, and capital movement oversight.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The euro is fully convertible. Spain maintains unrestricted current- and capital-account convertibility in accordance with Articles 63 to 66 of the Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union and Royal Decree 1816/1991. No prior exchange-control authorisation or administrative permit is required for the injection of equity capital into a Spanish Sociedad de Responsabilidad Limitada (SL) or for the repatriation of profits in the form of dividends. The only compliance burden is statistical: cross-border flows exceeding €50,000 or equivalent, or annual balances exceeding €50,000, must be reported to the Banco de España through the bank-intermediated Declaración de Operaciones con el Exterior (BE-1/BE-2) forms. Profit remittance in euros suffers no currency-based restriction; however, dividend payments to non-residents are subject to the general non-resident withholding tax rate of 19% (subject to applicable double-tax-treaty reduction to 5% or 0% with proper DTA certification).
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: There is no statutory surrender rule, no mandatory conversion ratio, and no compulsory repatriation period for export proceeds in Spain. Exporters may retain spot proceeds in EUR or in any convertible foreign currency indefinitely. For statistical and balance-of-payments completeness, exporters and their banks must declare each export transaction exceeding €50,000 or equivalent through the BE-1 export declaration channel. Failure to make the required declaration can result in administrative penalties under Law 10/2010 and Law 19/2003, but no conversion obligation exists.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account / Operational Account in EUR and multi-currency sub-account
Capital Escrow Account / Operational Account with FX treasury desk
Operational Account with SWIFT EUR and USD capabilities
Operational Account / Foreign-currency denominated account for LATAM receivables

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Medium. Spanish-licensed electronic money institutions (EMIs) and EEA-authorised EMIs passporting into Spain under the Revised Payment Services Directive (PSD2) may be viable for operational liquidity, same-day EUR payments, and multi-currency IBAN collection. However, they are not a substitute for a full credit institution in the areas of capital escrow, documentary export letters of credit (LC), or complex FX hedging. Cross-border digital-only EMIs incorporated outside the EEA are generally not eligible for Spanish corporate account opening because they cannot maintain a compliant AML/KYC relationship under Law 10/2010. Use an EEA EMIC with an authorised Spanish branch or agent for daily treasury only; reserve a tier-1 bank relationship for capital injections and LC settlements.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: For new non-resident corporate clients, most tier-1 Spanish banks require at least one director or the appointed legal representative (with sufficient power of attorney) to attend an initial physical KYC interview at a branch in Spain. Remote onboarding is possible only where the bank offers eIDAS-qualified video identification or an approved notarial certificate protocol. In practice, non-EU ultimate beneficial owners and directors of an offshore parent group may be required to appear in person or before a Spanish notary to execute the identification certificate. The capital contribution cannot be released or credited if onboarding is incomplete; the bank may open a dormant escrow account pending full AML risk classification.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Ultimate beneficial ownership (UBO) is held through an opaque offshore structure or non-EU trust.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified corporate registry extract of the parent chain, apostilled and sworn-translated into Spanish; UBO declaration under Law 10/2010; trust deed or foundation instrument showing the natural-person settlor and beneficiary; passport/NIE copies of every UBO; a structural chart certified by counsel; and a written legal opinion confirming transparency of ownership and source of funds.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident non-EU shareholders with no physical presence in Spain and no prior relationship with the bank.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Apostilled certificate of good-standing or register excerpt; notarial power of attorney to a Spanish representative; passport copies; board resolution approving the opening of the Spanish branch or subsidiary; evidence of real economic substance (office or warehouse lease, supplier agreements, employee or director CVs); and a commercial narrative for the Spanish entity.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Wholesale optical frames distribution creates large repetitive cross-border payments to Latin American manufacturers and buyers, some of whom may have elevated jurisdiction risk.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Complete written supply chain contracts with acetate-frame manufacturers; customer contracts and proforma invoices; shipping and customs documentation (bill of lading, airway bill, commercial invoice); warehouse lease and inventory reports; VAT registration certificate; and a projected cash-flow forecast showing transaction volume, counterparties, countries, and expected trade cycles.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: The bank flags mixed proceeds from emerging-market buyers or occasional conversion of cryptographically sourced funds.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Audited financial statements for at least two years; bank statements of the originating counterparty; reconciliation of each inbound transfer against the corresponding invoice, customs declaration, and freight documents; a sworn declaration of lawful origin of funds, and a strict policy of refusing any crypto-adjacent settlement until the commercial invoice and transfer provenance pass full compliance.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant routing for non-resident shareholder capital contribution into the Spanish SL: instruct a SWIFT MT103 from the parent entity's bank to the SL's segregated euro account at the Spanish bank. Use the beneficiary NIF (CIF) in field 50K/57D/59A and place in field 70 the trade code 'APORTACION CAPITAL SOCIAL' together with the constitution-certificate reference or notarised capital-increase deed number. For Banco de España statistical purposes, the bank will require the external operation concept to be classified as a direct-investment capital contribution; the corresponding BE-1 declaration will be filed using the Banco de España concept classification for 'direct investment - capital subscriptions/contributions by non-residents in resident companies'. No prior exchange approval is required, but the bank may request a certificate from the registry or a certified copy of the public deed if the capital amount exceeds ordinary onboarding thresholds. The bank will not release the funds until the Articles of Association or capital increase resolution is filed at the Commercial Registry and the NIF has been obtained.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For international trade settlements involving wholesale distribution of acetate eyeglass frames the group should use, in order of operational preference: (i) SWIFT MT103 for telegraphic transfers to suppliers and for payments to confirmed sellers, with the invoice number and ISIC context in the payment details; (ii) commercial letters of credit (SWIFT MT700/MT710) on an irrevocable, confirmed-by-correspondent-bank basis for high-value shipments to Latin American buyers, ensuring compliance with UCP 600; (iii) SEPA Credit Transfer (SCT) within the SEPA zone for EU suppliers and intra-group EUR payments; (iv) documentary collections (CAD/DP) for medium-risk trade partners. Where the buyer's country applies exchange or import-license formalities, include the local customs reference and tax withholding codes in accompanying documents. For Latin American receivers, prefer USD-cleared MT103 to a correspondent bank and advise the counterparty to procure local peso settlement via their own bank treasury rather than through inconvenient USD-denominated local collection accounts.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Plain vanilla EUR/USD FX forwards executed under an ISDA Master Agreement or a bank-approved FX Master with a Tier-1 Spanish or EEA credit institution, strictly back-to-back against forecast commercial receivables or payables.

Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) in restricted or illiquid Latin American currencies (e.g., ARS, CLP, COP, MXN) with a bank treasury desk, used solely to hedge foreseeable trade-account exposures and never for speculative positions.
EUR/foreign-currency cross-currency swaps (CCS) for aligning the currency of the ES_SL equity injection and future dollar or Latin American currency commercial flows with the EUR capital base.
FX options (vanilla puts/calls) as a permitted but conservative hedge layer, limited to committed purchase orders or contracted receivables and subject to board-approved risk limits.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual legalisation of obligatory corporate books (Libro de Actas, Libro Registro de Socios, Libro Diario, Libro de Inventario y Cuentas Anuales)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 4 months after fiscal year-end; for calendar-year SLs, by 30 April each year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Unlegalised books lose evidentiary value and may block later registry filings; administrative penalties may be imposed on administrators

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Deposit of annual financial statements (Cuentas Anuales) comprising balance sheet, profit and loss account, statement of changes in equity, and notes
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registro Mercantil Provincial (Commercial Registry) with oversight by Instituto de Contabilidad y Auditoría de Cuentas (ICAC)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: General meeting must approve accounts within 6 months after fiscal year-end and deposit within 1 month after approval; for calendar-year SLs, approval by 30 June and filing by 31 July
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Statutory fine under Ley de Sociedades de Capital of €1,200–€60,000; provisional closure of the company's registral sheet until accounts are filed; legal liability of administrators

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual beneficial ownership confirmation / update of the Beneficial Ownership Register (Registro de Titularidades Reales)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registro de Titularidades Reales administered by the Registro Mercantil
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: No separate recurring return if no ownership change occurs; update immediately upon change of beneficial owner and confirm concurrently with annual accounts deposit (by 31 July for calendar-year SLs)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fines under Ley 10/2010 for failure to update or for false beneficial-ownership data, ranging up to €100,000 for very serious infractions

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory independent audit for an SL if, for two consecutive years, at least two of the following three thresholds are exceeded: total assets > €2,850,000; annual net turnover > €5,700,000; average employee headcount > 50. Mandatory audit also applies to listed companies or entities forming part of a group required to present consolidated accounts.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Spanish GAAP as set out in the Plan General de Contabilidad (RD 1514/2007), with the simplified PGC de PYMES (RD 1515/2007) available for eligible small entities; IFRS-EU for consolidated accounts of public-interest entities where applicable.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Spanish law does not require a separate annual UBO return when no ownership changes occur. Every acquisition or loss of beneficial ownership must be declared to the Registro de Titularidades Reales through the Commercial Registry. Share transfers in an SL must be formalised in a notarised public deed, recorded in the Libro Registro de Socios, and reflected in the registry declaration. The annual deposit of Cuentas Anuales serves as the periodic confirmation point that the registered UBO information remains accurate and up to date.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Libro Registro de Socios (Register of Members)
Libro de Actas (Minute Book for Shareholders' Meetings and Board Meetings, if applicable)
Libro Diario, de Inventario y Cuentas Anuales (Journal, Inventory and Annual Accounts Book)
Libro de Contratos con el Socio Único (Contracts with the Sole Shareholder Book, required only where the SL is a single-member company)
